|translation='''Title:''' Rebel Commander.

'''Card text:'''
All other Rebels at the same location except leaders are forfeit +1. When deploying a Bothan spy at the same location, you need not spend Force.

'''Lore:'''
Major Bob Hudsol is a typical hawkish Corellian officer, but he prefers cautious tactics in actual combat. He is the leader of the resistance in Bothan space and firmly controls the region's spy network.
